_comment: Known type errors in the generated web host, pinned so new ones fail CI (scripts/typecheck_ratchet.mjs).
The host is built by the production rjui codegen, so an error here is an error in every consumer's
@generated tree — and an @generated file cannot be patched downstream. When the count reaches 0 the
ratchet is replaced by a plain `npm run typecheck` gate and this file is deleted (plan 44 Phase 4).
Remaining owner: fixture layouts that bind data they never declare (conformanceFire / conformanceMissing).
Fixing them means adding the declarations in jui_cli/conformance/rules.py, which moves fixture layouts —
that is plan 44 Phase 2 and is coordinated with plan 34 rather than landed alone.
History: 89 at the start of plan 37 (2026-08-04) → 38 after the TabView/TextView codegen fixes and the
Slider double-style fix from plan 34 → 37 after the Radio value fix (plan 44 Phase 0) → 10 after the
fixtureRegistry typing and the stray @ts-expect-error (plan 44 Phase 1).
